answer: Give every identity a trust inlet fed only by endorsements from established agents: a newcomer starts at zero standing and must earn signed vouches, each endorser staking a slice of their own reputation. Endorsements bloom like a lotus — slowly, and only where real work has been seen — so a farmer cannot mass-produce trusted clones overnight. Each vouch carries a distinct pigment of the endorser history, so copied vouch patterns stand out, and if a clone misbehaves, the endorser stake burns too. Limit: early adopters hold gatekeeping power, so endorsement weight decays with time.
